250 days = 8 months (approx) but need exact count.  
1131 is not a leap year (divisible by 4? 1131/4=282.75, no).  
From 12-11-1131:  
Days in Nov 1131: 30, so 12 Nov → 30 Nov = 18 days.  
250 - 18 = 232 days left.  
Dec 1131: 31 days → 232 - 31 = 201 left, now in 1132.  
Jan 1132: 31 → 170 left.  
Feb 1132: 1132 divisible by 4? Yes (1132/4=283), leap year → 29 days → 141 left.  
Mar 1132: 31 → 110 left.  
Apr 1132: 30 → 80 left.  
May 1132: 31 → 49 left.  
Jun 1132: 30 → 19 left.  
Jul 1132: 19 days → date is 19 July 1132.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1132-07-19
